---

## Installation

Install the ESM-only Node.js API with `pnpm`:

```bash
pnpm add @teambit/oxc.linter.oxlint-node
```

## Usage

### Simple Usage

```javascript
import { OxlintNode } from '@teambit/oxc.linter.oxlint-node';

const oxlintNode = OxlintNode.create({});
const result = await oxlintNode.run(['paths']);
console.log(result);
```

### Advanced Usage

```javascript
const oxlintNode = OxlintNode.create({
  binPath: 'path to oxlint binary',
  formats: ['json', 'default'],
  configPath: 'path to oxlint config file',
  tsconfigPath: 'path to tsconfig',
  pluginsFlags: {
    'plugin-name': true,
  },
  rulesFlags: [{
    name: 'rule-name',
    severity: 'warn',
  }],
  fixesFlags: {
    all: true,
  },
  typeAware: true,
});
```

`OxlintNode` resolves the matching `oxlint-tsgolint` native binary when
`typeAware` or `typeCheck` is enabled. Output formats are executed sequentially,
so requesting fixes together with multiple formats cannot race while writing files.

## Contributing

This low-level wrapper uses `bitdev.node/node-env` for its modern ESM Node.js
toolchain. Wrapper behavior is exercised by the integration tests in the
dependent `oxlint-linter` component, whose Vitest pipeline runs them in local
validation and Ripple CI.

We welcome contributions! Please read our [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/teambit/oxlint-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started.
